paragraphs: Rabbi Yosef Tzirnaa, in Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s time—I did not find mention of him. Perhaps he is Rabbi Yosef Tzaydena, who spoke in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, or Rav Yosef Tzirona above, who lived in Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai’s days, and a shin was exchanged for a nun in the abbreviation RNBY.
